name: Refusal or delay in answering due diligence requests
description: Customer or counterparty delays, refuses or gives incomplete or evasive responses to KYC, refresh or request-for-information enquiries.
fp: Genuine administrative delay or language barriers can look similar; check for repeat patterns.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services (2016)
Wolfsberg Group, Correspondent Banking Due Diligence Questionnaire (CBDDQ) (current version, specify year)
Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Guidelines: Sound management of risks related to money laundering and financing of terrorism (2014, rev. 2020)

links.name: Unwillingness or inability to provide information
links.ctx: Customer delays, refuses or gives evasive answers to KYC or refresh requests, or withdraws when questioned.
links.fp: Customers may be privacy-conscious, unfamiliar with requirements or have genuinely lost documents.

links.name: Respondent refuses or delays information requests
links.ctx: Slow, evasive or incomplete responses to RFIs.
